english: Gin Tama were popular on my planet too.
It's gone now. No home to go back to...
I see... I'll try that next time.
Dragon Tama... lie beyond Gin Tama battles.
You... Good at Gin Tama battles?

Force or weak-point Kotodama can beat weak foes...\fBut experienced fighters won't go down that easily.\fLook through your Gin Tama for useful Effect Gin Tama...\fMost foes have attack patterns. Watch, then turn them against them...\fNothing beats landing a strategy just right.
Gin Tama? Thanks, I'll take it.
I'm not a kid. You don't have to tell me to watch out.
Please, take it. Kanshichiro's all I need.
What if I go to sleep tonight and don't dream of Kanshichiro...?
Right. Don't mind if I do.
Keep it down, you drunk! You're a nuisance!
Go easy on the evil schemes.
YOU'RE the villain! I'm busy. I'll question you later.
Well, I've never even seen one.
If I knew, I'd be making a fuss by now.
Yeah... Plenty of monster-like folks here.
Yeah, no need to worry about me, granny.
Gin Tama? You sure I can have it?
Good. That's reassuring. Here... Take this.
Don't mock me for being old. I was a peerless beauty in my day.
The rare Gin Tama that grant a wish if you get all seven?
Never seen one. Don't know a thing.
What would you do with Dragon Tama?
I could lend you a hand.
Right. Tell me anything you know.
Why not come work here? Such a waste...
Running low on Gin Tama from all those battles? Take these.
Don't tell Mama I gave you Gin Tama...
Oh, right. Seen any shady types?
Could I have just a little sip of your blood?
Yes... I should watch my diet too.
So I'm up all night, wandering here and there for blood.
Eek...!\fI haven't even said anything yet!
No choice... Off to the she-gorilla's.
I'm not THAT reckless. She has ingredients, right? Shinpachi can cook.
It's fine. After all I've done for him...
Guess I'll have to sell my Gin Tama...
Fine! I'll listen. Now feed me.
Yes, ma'am... I'll shut up and listen.
Right. People will pay to get what they want.\fAnd pay a fortune for rare Dragon Tama.
I see... A Gin Tama black-market broker. Sounds fun.
Isn't it obvious?\fWe help ourselves to the broker's Gin Tama.
Hold on. Think about it.\fHe's a shady broker. Practically a criminal.
If we rob a bad guy, is he going to call the cops?
Why not? Yorozuya means we do anything.
The voice of the voiceless. Like that.
Then call it our shady sideline.
You're such a pain...\fIf words won't work, we'll settle it with a match!
Fine. But I won't hold back.
Gonna give us a free meal?
The ones that grant a wish if you get seven?
Then hand him to the cops?
Hello, I'm a bad guy. Someone stole my Gin Tama.
You good-for-nothing!\fNo free meal for you! Think again!
If you get it, go home!
You know...\fAnything that draws a crowd...\fDraws all kinds of crooks too.
They say there's a shady Gin Tama broker.
Lots of people want Gin Tama.\fBut nobody knows how they're supplied.
Gin, no luck today. Let's go home.
What are you saying? That's impossible!
I-I won't...\fThey're a present for Otsu!
No, Kagura.\fA crook who gets Gin Tama in bulk and sells them on the black market.
Now you mention it, that IS odd...
But how do you trade that many Gin Tama?
Gin, don't tell me you're going to catch the broker?
But! What you're planning is a crime, Gin!
Don't wanna hear it! Don't say it!
Aah! I don't wanna hear it!
Does that make you a good guy?!
No! That's still wrong!\fThat's not a job for Yorozuya!
Nobody asked us to do that!
If I win, you drop this whole idea.
Yeah... That Gin Tama match made me hungry...
I'm really not keen on this...
All right... But is this really okay...?
See? I can do it if I try!
Finally, time to become a character with personality!
A chance to get loads of Gin Tama, my friend.
All the Gin Tama you could ever give Otsu.
